comments.author: yakshaver
comments.text: Benchmarks like this live or die on the corpus. Real-world JSON is mostly small objects with repeated keys, not the 100 MB twitter dump every parser optimises for. Did you measure per-document latency on small payloads or just bulk throughput?

replies.author: trailingcomma
replies.text: Both, and the small-payload table surprised me most: the throughput champions invert order completely once you include setup cost per document. It is the second chart, easy to miss below the fold.
